passage:
Mia's family installed a doorbell camera. At first, they used it only to see who was outside.
One day, the camera recorded an old man picking up a package that had fallen from the mail carrier's bag. He placed it carefully by the door and walked away.
Mia's father posted a thank-you note near the gate. The next morning, the old man passed by and smiled when he saw it.
Mia realized the camera did not only record problems. It could also record kindness that might have gone unnoticed.
Technology often makes people think about safety, but it can also help people see good actions. A small camera showed that someone had done the right thing when no one seemed to be watching.
